blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: I have a memory like a sieve.
exercises.ru: У меня не память, ___ решето.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Now, take a deep breath.
exercises.ru: ___ теперь глубоко вдохните.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Not wanting to is the reason; not being able to is just an excuse.
exercises.ru: Причина - нежелание, ___ неспособность - это всего лишь оправдание.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm not an astrologer; I'm an economist.
exercises.ru: Я экономист, ___ не астролог.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The data piled up, but no one systematized and analyzed it.
exercises.ru: Данные копились, ___ их никто не систематизировал и не анализировал.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Daniel Naroditsky is gone, but his chess legacy is immortal!
exercises.ru: Даниила Народицкого больше нет, ___ его шахматное наследие бессмертно!
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The book has been reprinted several times, and is also available online.
exercises.ru: Книга выдержала несколько переизданий, ___ также доступна онлайн.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Patience is bitter, but its fruits are sweet.
exercises.ru: Терпение - с горечью, ___ плоды его сладкие.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm not trying to stir up trouble. I'm just telling you what I heard.
exercises.ru: Я не думаю мутить воду, ___ просто передаю, что слышал.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom sleeps on the bottom bunk of their bunk bed, while Mary sleeps on the top bunk.
exercises.ru: Том спит на первом этаже двухъярусной кровати, ___ Мэри — на втором.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The part of a verb, that is partly a verb and partly an adjective, we call a participle.
exercises.ru: Часть глагола, которая частично является глаголом, ___ частично прилагательным, называется причастием.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Lions don't miaow, they roar.
exercises.ru: Львы не мяукают, ___ рычат.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Rights are not given, they are fought for.
exercises.ru: Права не даются, ___ завоёвываются.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A wise son listens to his father's instruction, but an unruly one does not listen to reproof.
exercises.ru: Мудрый сын слушает наставление отца, ___ буйный не слушает обличения.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: No matter how vigorous the lie, you cannot escape the truth.
exercises.ru: Как резва ни будь ложь, ___ от правды не уйдёшь.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This coffee tastes like dishwater.
exercises.ru: Это не кофе, ___ помои какие-то.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: For me, being a doctor isn't a job, it's a calling.
exercises.ru: Быть врачом - для меня это не профессия, ___ призвание.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Truth has a lovely face, but torn clothing.
exercises.ru: У правды красивое лицо, ___ рваная одежда.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You got sunflower oil, but I asked for olive oil.
exercises.ru: Ты купил подсолнечного масла, ___ я просила оливковое.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This isn't the original. It's a remix.
exercises.ru: Это не оригинал, ___ ремикс.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
